CVE-2019-10249 applies to Xtext and Xtend versions prior to 2.18.0. This project uses Xtext 2.38.0. org.eclipse.emf.ecore.xcore.lib has separate versioning and is a false positive for this CVE. See https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-10249.

CVE-2020-27225 applies to Eclipse Platform 4.18 and earlier. Dependency Check reports this through broad Eclipse CPE matching, but the CDM build does not ship or run the vulnerable Eclipse Help subsystem. See https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-27225.
